reviews.text: The service was great !!
MINDY IS THE GREATEST‼️
We are always enthusiastically greeted by the Manager and assistance is always offered. This is my dog’s favorite store!
Beautiful cut
Everything went smoothly and it was a great experience!
Love this spot!
My pup looks fantastic after his grooming. Thanks!
The Pooch always comes back clean, shiny and smelling good!
Great groomer  and the best front people

Wonderful A to Z. We just had our 4th grooming appointment with our skittish, 8 month old Shiba Inu pup. Mindy is so great with her - I was pleased to see the airplane ears when Mikan saw her.
She does a great job with the nail grind and Mikan always smells so fresh and even though she’s shaking, I know she’s happy. And we are happy too!
Cute spot with adorable shop kitty and friendly staff!

Got a coupon for 25% off a dog grooming, only to be told when we dropped the dog off that the ‘manager wouldn’t honor it’ - I understand that circumstances change but don’t offer something if you don’t intend to honor it. Grooming was fine but over priced. Won’t be back.

Doggies Style gives dogs second chance to a beautiful life. That is where our Rudy, the Australian Cattle Dog
adopted us❣️
Just adopted our sweet girl, Spooky. Everyone was so kind and helpful. I'm sure we'll be visiting frequently for Spooky 's needs and treats!
Taylor was so kind and gentle with my dog’s nails. Thank you!

Great CS and people working!

They nearly doubled their cost from the previous service - that's not inflation!

Not sure I'd go back.
They do such a good job with my dog he's Been coming here for 3 years now always satisfied!!!
Friendly employees. Loved meeting Casper the manager (the cat)

The BEST grooming experience I've ever had. My Husky was way overdue for a groom & had so much fur coming out. This was the best groom job I've ever seen done on her. She was so soft, smelled great for weeks & little to no shedding after the services. Incredible. Thank you SO much!
Our dog, Mick always looks great and is bathed and groomed within 90 minutes.

My dog, Mabel, loves visiting Doggie Style for grooming! She’s a tri-pawd and generally anxious dog but the staff are always so kind and patient with her. She’s been groomed by Malik twice now and I can tell Mabel is a fan when she greets him!
I was lucky enough to be able to adopt the sweetest girl from Doggie Style Queens Village. The staff were so caring and kind. Adoption process was made so easy. The entire staff was wonderful.

Paris came out looking so dashing.. The groomer listening to all of my needs and you can tell Paris was happy with it as well. We were traveling the next day. The day of our travel he was so proud looking so handsome with his fluffy haircut. Oh Paris.

I went to this store location with my dog after the snowfall because a cold front was coming in and she also began limping after the excessive salting of the roads. The staff member was very attentive and helpful in showing me options for what I asked for: coats and boots for my girl. She was patient, helping us try on coats for sizing in all price ranges and making sure I was aware of the cost, without being pushy! She also helped me pick out boots and taught me how to put them on properly, ensuring I knew the commitment of the work it took to put on the product, which I very much appreciated! Will absolutely return.

Daisy (my JRT) and I LOVE Doggie Style Pets QV. They are so friendly and knowledgeable. All of the groomers have been excellent, Daisy never has any issues and it's a super smooth booking, checking in and paying experience. 10/10 would recommend!

I just had my pup groomed for the second time by Malik. He’s very gentle, but efficient. My very anxious Lucy comes out smelling fresh with her tail wagging! (a huge accomplishment)
I have tried groomers between Fairmount and Queen Village over the last few years and I finally found one I am ready to commit to! #crazydogmomapproved
Had another great experience with Malik!
Malik was wonderful with our goldendoodle! He went out of his way to ensure we both had a great experience!!
Really nice and informative staff

This was my first experience shopping at a Doggy style Pets, and I'll definitely be back! They have so many g
food options for cats, they have their own huge section. The sales associate (I think Steve was his name) was welcoming, Kasper the cat manager kept everyone in line lol. When I got to the checkout, Prices are fantastic  too!
Great service, friendly people, trustworthy! Good value.
Great food and service
